svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.18.4 Rooms and Spaces Requiring Heat Detectors or Smoke Detectors
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.18.4 Rooms and Spaces Requiring Heat Detectors or Smoke Detectors
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Rooms and Spaces Requiring Heat Detectors or Smoke Detectors

g.text: KEY, BUILDING WITH A FIRE ALARM SYSTEM REQUIRED
Smoke detector: every public corridor in a residential building and every exit stair shaft, (1)
Fire detector, heat or smoke: rooms listed in (2), building not sprinklered
Dwelling units: the detectors of Sentence (2) are not required, (3). Smoke alarms are covered in 9.10.19.

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Where a fire alarm system is required, every public
corridor in buildings of residential occupancy and
every exit stair shaft is provided with smoke
detectors
If a fire alarm system is required in a building
that is not sprinklered, fire detectors are
installed in the following spaces
(a) storage rooms not within dwelling units, (b) service
rooms not within dwelling units, (c) janitors' rooms,
(d) rooms in which hazardous substances are to be used
or stored (see Note A-3.3.1.2.(1)), (e) elevator
hoistways, chutes and dumbwaiter shafts, and (f) laundry
rooms in buildings of residential occupancy, but not
those within dwelling units. Except as provided in
Sentence (3).
Heat detectors and smoke detectors described in
Sentence (2) are not required in dwelling units
Or in sprinklered buildings in which the sprinkler
system is electrically supervised and equipped with a
water flow alarm.
Fire detector (Division A, 1.4.1.2.)
A device that detects a fire condition and automatically
initiates an electrical signal to actuate an alert
signal or alarm signal. It includes heat detectors and
smoke detectors.
Drawn: one floor of a residential building, not sprinklered, walls cut low. Detectors are shown as discs on the plan.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.18.4. (page 9-96), with Division A, Article 1.4.1.2.
